label: Slanted
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Sharp 1200x1200 real photograph of a jacket sleeve end in dusty-rose slubby linen/wool, cuff vent turned back to show the check lining. Four cream 4-hole buttons sit in a kissing row along the vent edge and four hand-worked buttonholes in rust silk sit alongside them; each buttonhole's long axis is clearly rotated well off the perpendicular of the button row (roughly 25-30 degrees off square), i.e. worked on the diagonal — the Italian slanted buttonhole the label names, not a square/horizontal buttonhole. A white arrow has been pasted in pointing directly at the buttonhole group, so the intended subject is unambiguous. Counts match a 4-button sleeve: 4 buttons, 4 buttonholes, with visible hand gimp and bar tacks.
